name: Southern Utah Summer 2022

venue.name: [Dixie Convention Center](https://dixiecenter.com/)
venue.address: 1835 Convention Center Dr,  St. George, UT 84790

information: * Please review the [COVID Precautions tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernUtahSummer2022#17229-covid-precautions) before registering. * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * No outside food and drink is allowed in the venue. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first competition, [this video](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) will provide you with much of the information you need. * All first-time competitors should be present for the competitor tutorial at 9:00 AM.
